name: Kahlua Siphon
original_name: カルーア・サイフォン
source:
Occupation: Succubus
Hobbies: Dirty Stuff!

A succubus lives by draining the life force of humans and they live for far longer period of time than humans do.
Initially, she stands in the protagonists' way as his enemy. Her purpose and origin are completely unknown.

What is Kahlua's true objective in pursuing the protagonists..?
